review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位概述： 系统工程师是连接客户需求与技术实现的核心桥梁。将负责商用电动车控制器（如 VCU、MCU、TCU）的系统级架构设计和需求定义。需要将整车级的目标转化成明确的软硬件技术规范，并在整个开发周期（V模型）中确保系统集成、功能安全及性能达标，以满足卡车和巴士在严苛工况下的运营需求。 岗位职责： 1. 需求分析与分解： 深入对接 OEM 客户，收集并分析整车需求。将原始需求分解为系统级需求、硬件需求及软件需求。 2. 系统架构设计： 定义控制器的系统拓扑结构、软硬分区及内部/外部接口。确保架构具备高扩展性和鲁棒性。 3. 通讯与网络设计： 负责车载网络方案设计，重点包括商用车标准的 J1939 协议矩阵设计、CAN-FD 及以太网通讯规划。 4. 功能安全协同： 配合功能安全经理（FSM），将安全目标（ASIL）转化为具体的技术安全要求（TSR），并落实到系统设计中。 5. 控制策略定义： 定义关键整车控制逻辑，如能量回收策略、扭矩分配方案、高压上下电逻辑及热管理协调。 6. 系统集成测试： 制定系统集成计划，主导 HIL（硬件在环）测试及整车环境下的系统功能验证，分析并解决复杂的系统级故障。 任职要求： 1. 教育背景： 车辆工程、电子工程、自动化或相关专业本科及以上学历。 2. 核心经验： 熟练英语口语表达能力。 5年以上 汽车电子系统开发经验，有 VCU、MCU 或整车动力总成控制器经验者优先。 熟悉商用车特有的系统特征（如 24V 系统、双回路气制动、多驱动轴控制等）。 2. 专业技能： 精通 V模型 开发流程和 ASPICE 标准。 熟练掌握 MATLAB/Simulink 建模仿真以及 Vector 工具链（CANoe, CANape）。 熟悉 ISO 26262 并在系统设计中应用过 HARA 和 FMEA。 3. 素质要求： 具备极强的系统性思维，能够从全局视角处理软硬件冲突；具备良好的跨部门沟通能力。

review_candidates.title: Platform Engineer (Senior/Lead)
review_candidates.description: At Scott Logic, we have a reputation for world-class software delivery. We are trusted by some of the world’s leading organisations to build reliable, high-performance, business-critical solutions – and expert advice. Many of our clients look to us to lead across the full software lifecycle, from initial conception through to production deployment and beyond. Our Platform Engineers are a vital part of this – designing, building and managing cloud infrastructure and delivery platforms to support modern DevOps practices. Their work includes CI/CD processes and deployment pipelines, building the platform infrastructure to deliver robust, cost-effective services to end users at scale, and supporting all stages of migrating complex systems from on-premises infrastructure to a multitude of cloud providers. These are hands-on, client-facing roles, with openings at senior or lead level to suit your experience. You may be leading teams, setting technical direction, advising clients or solving tough engineering challenges. Our clients include large global corporations and government departments, and you’ll be working on systems that make a difference to millions of people, within a company that is friendly, welcoming, and where individual contributions always make a difference. Our Platform Engineers combine a deep level of fundamental knowledge of how to deploy and maintain reliable and scalable systems, with a broad awareness of wider software engineering principles and experience with the latest DevOps tooling, both cloud and on-prem. We’re technology-agnostic and we’re open minded when it comes to your existing skillset. What are we looking for? You’ve worked with modern Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation or Bicep. You are familiar with one or more major cloud platform, particularly AWS or Azure. You have good CI/CD and deployment automation experience. You’re comfortable using Python or other scripting languages for DevOps tasks. You’re a problem-solver, pragmatically exploring options and finding effective solutions. You have strong communication skills and take a collaborative approach to your work. You have an interest in good practices around security, reliability, observability, cost efficiency, performance and governance – collaborating with others to ensure these are in place. For lead roles, you have good technical leadership experience, understanding what makes a team successful and how to support colleagues in their own career development. Experience with containerisation, Kubernetes or working with data platforms is nice-to-have. What You'll Get In Return Is 25 days’ annual leave, rising incrementally to 30 days after six years of service. Generous family leave policies. Access to an employer pension scheme and Group Life Assurance. A range of optional benefits such as discounted gym membership and a cycle-to-work scheme. A meaningful approach to evaluating your performance and providing feedback on your progress. At Scott Logic, we value the flexibility of remote working alongside the value gained from spending time with our colleagues and clients. In our offices you’ll find employee-led clubs and events, as well as free games, books, and refreshments. We have shared values that govern our behaviour toward others and the environment. We are proud to be a B Corp, a global movement of businesses driving for a more inclusive, equitable, and regenerative economy.

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 🧩 基础架构团队-架构工程师（Staff/Principal） 📌 职位概述 我们正在建设面向未来的基础设施体系（多云 + 混合云 + 数据与 AI 场景），现招聘一名架构工程师，参与并drive整体 Infra 架构的设计、治理与持续演进。 该角色将作为 Infra 架构领域的关键干系人，与各子团队（网络、系统与云、DevOps、数据AI）及产品、研发团队紧密协作，建立架构标准与准入体系，并确保从设计到落地的全流程合规与质量闭环，持续提升平台的稳定性、可扩展性与效率。 🚀 岗位职责 1️⃣ 应用基础架构评估与整体把控（Architecture Ownership） 负责应用系统技术部署架构的评估与把关，输出专业架构评估意见 识别系统在高可用、扩展性、性能、成本等方面的风险，并推动优化方案落地 支撑资源规划、容量评估及生产部署，确保架构合理性与可持续演进 主导关键系统架构评审，建立标准化评估方法与流程 2️⃣ 基础架构标准与治理体系建设（Governance） 牵头制定并持续迭代基础架构标准体系，覆盖但不限于： 网络、计算（虚拟化 / 容器）、存储、CI/CD 数据库、中间件、大数据平台 建立架构治理机制（Architecture Review / ADR / 技术选型规范） 推动现有架构梳理与技术债治理，提升整体架构一致性与可维护性 建立架构质量指标体系（如 SLA / SLO / 可用性 / 容灾等级） 3️⃣ 架构准入与落地治理（Architecture Guardrails & Enforcement） 深度参与产品研发、平台建设及第三方系统采购流程，提供前置架构评估与约束 建立并持续完善 Infra 架构准入标准（Architecture Guardrails），包括： 高可用与容灾等级（HA / 多 AZ / 多 Region / BCDR） 技术选型规范（数据库 / 中间件 / 云资源） 安全与网络架构要求（隔离、访问控制等） 将架构标准嵌入研发与采购流程（Design Review / Tech Review / Vendor Evaluation），形成前置管控机制 对关键系统及第三方引入系统进行架构合规性评估（Architecture Compliance Review） 主导上线前架构验证与测试，包括： 高可用与容灾验证（Failover / 灾备演练） 架构设计与实际部署一致性校验（Design vs Implementation） 推动问题整改闭环，确保架构标准真正落地执行 4️⃣跨团队协同与架构落地（Influence） 联动网络、系统与云、DevOps、数据 AI 等团队，推动架构优化方案落地 在复杂跨团队场景中承担技术牵引角色，提升整体架构一致性 参与架构委员会工作，输出评审结论及改进建议 🎯 任职要求 （一）基本要求 本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、网络工程等相关专业优先 8 年及以上基础架构 / 运维 / 平台工程经验，有架构设计或架构治理经验优先 具备良好的英文能力，可阅读英文技术文档并进行技术沟通 具备优秀的跨团队沟通与推动能力，能够主导复杂技术方案落地 具备较强的系统性思考能力与问题分析能力 （二）核心能力要求 架构能力（重点） 具备应用系统整体架构评估能力（高可用、扩展性、容灾、性能、成本） 有 BCDR（多活 / 异地多活 / 灾备）设计或落地经验优先 能建立和推动架构标准、规范及最佳实践落地 具备架构风险识别与治理能力 具备自动化开发能力（熟练掌握Python / Go / Shell 等一门开发语言） 熟悉 IaC、GitOps DevOps / 平台能力 深入理解 CI/CD 架构及流程设计（如 Jenkins / GitLab CI / ArgoCD 等） 有复杂流水线优化、稳定性提升及大规模应用支持经验优先 数据库与中间件 熟悉主流数据库（关系型 / NoSQL）及中间件的架构设计、部署与运维 熟悉集群架构、备份恢复、性能优化及高可用方案 能制定统一的架构标准与运维规范 基础设施能力 熟悉网络、计算（容器 / 虚拟化）、存储等核心基础设施技术 有公有云（如腾讯云）及混合云架构经验优先 具备资源规划与成本优化（FinOps）意识 （三）加分项 有零售行业或大规模分布式系统经验 熟悉多数据中心 / 多地域架构 熟悉大数据平台基础架构（如 Hadoop / Spark / Lakehouse 等） 持有云厂商、数据库或 DevOps 相关认证

Soft Skills: High level of influence, commercial diplomacy for dealing with Chinese state-owned enterprises/institutions, and the ability to work effectively within complex, matrix, and multicultural organizations.

review_candidates.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
review_candidates.description: About The Company The Arab Lens is a renowned organization dedicated to fostering cultural understanding and promoting artistic expression through innovative visual storytelling. With a focus on Middle Eastern narratives, The Arab Lens serves as a platform for emerging and established photographers, filmmakers, and visual artists to showcase their work and engage with a global audience. Our mission is to bridge cultural gaps, highlight diverse perspectives, and contribute to the rich tapestry of regional and international arts and media. Committed to excellence and integrity, The Arab Lens continuously strives to create impactful content that educates, inspires, and sparks meaningful conversations about identity, heritage, and societal change. About The Role We are seeking a highly motivated and creative Content Coordinator to join The Arab Lens team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and curating visual and written content across various platforms, including our website, social media channels, and publications. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail, excellent communication skills, and a passion for visual storytelling and cultural dialogue. You will work closely with artists, editors, and marketing teams to ensure that all content aligns with our mission and brand standards. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a dynamic organization that is making a significant impact in the arts and media landscape of the Middle East and beyond. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a bachelor's degree in Communications, Media Studies, Arts, or a related field. Proven experience in content management, social media, or digital marketing is highly desirable. Strong written and verbal communication skills, along with proficiency in content editing and storytelling, are essential. Familiarity with visual arts, photography, and filmmaking will be considered an advantage. The candidate should demonstrate excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. A passion for cultural issues and a deep understanding of Middle Eastern contexts will be beneficial. Responsibilities Develop and implement content strategies that align with The Arab Lens’s mission and objectives. Curate and manage visual and textual content for online platforms, ensuring consistency and quality. Collaborate with artists, contributors, and internal teams to gather and produce compelling content. Monitor and analyze content performance metrics, adjusting strategies to maximize engagement and reach. Manage social media accounts, including scheduling posts, engaging with followers, and growing the online community. Assist in the planning and execution of special projects, exhibitions, and publications. Maintain an organized archive of all content, ensuring easy access and proper documentation. Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies relevant to digital content and visual storytelling. review_candidates.title: Traffic Management Specialist
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: Job Description The Traffic Management Specialist arranges the shipment of Pre-positioned Global Prepositioned Material Services (GPMS) cargo to various worldwide destinations via air, land and sea. The Incumbent must comply with all applicable International and Federal Transportation Laws, Regulations, Tariffs and Department of Defense (DOD) guidance. Must be able to gain access to Logistics Tool Suite (LTS), Global Freight Management (GFM), Cargo Movement Operating System (CMOS), Integrated Logistics System-Supply (ILS-S), Global Air Transportation Execution System (GATES), Integrated Computerized Deployment System (ICODES), Integrated Booking System (IBS), Joint Container Management system (JCM), Wood Packaging Materials (WPM) Management Toolset, Global Asset Reporting Tool (GART) and web-based tracking systems such as Integrated Data Environment/Global Transportation Network Convergence (IGC), Radio Frequency Identification (RFID-ITV) Tracking Portal, Global Decision Support Systems (GDSS-2) and Single Mobility System (SMS) to ensure In-transit Visibility (ITV) within the Defense Transportation System (DTS). Ensures all shipments comply with the International Trade and Arms Regulations (ITAR), the Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Amentum ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS). Must be able to complete AMMO-43, Intermodal Dry Cargo Container/CSC Reinspection, AMMO-62, Technical Transportation of Hazardous Materials Distance Learning Courses, and WPM certification/recertification web-based training. Ensures compliance with Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Amentum ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS). Principal Accountabilities Inspects, accepts documentation (DD Form 1149/1348-1), prepares and processes all outbound/inbound cargo offered for transportation in the Defense Transportation System (DTS). Checks for completeness and accuracy. Verifies the Nomenclatures, Quantity, Transportation Control Numbers (TCN), Transportation Account Code (TAC), Consignor and Consignee Codes, Hazardous/Classified materials, ITARS certifications and other essential transportation data. Properly classified freight, selects commodity codes, selects the most efficient mode of shipment and controls obligations for government transportation funds. Prepares all required shipping documents for data input to CMOS/GATES, assigns Transportation Control Numbers, produces labels, issues truck manifest for general/hazardous cargo and Maintains Manifest logs. Uses automated computer systems to process and document to accurately input the Transportation Control Numbers, Transportation Accounting Codes, consignor and consignee codes and other essential transportation data into CMOS, GATES or IBS. Inspects Hazardous Materials to ensure proper packaging, marking, labeling, documentation and certification in accordance with applicable Dangerous Goods Regulations (AFMAN 24-604, 49 Code of Federal Regulation, International Air Transport Association (IATA) and International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG). Inspects, accepts and inventories all incoming freight and containers for overages, shortages and damage before acceptance. When required, initiate and complete DD Form 361, Transportation Discrepancy Report (TDR). Provides asset visibility and real-time view to track customer queries using IGC, RFID-ITV, GDSS2 or SMS. Prepares shipping documents and Movement Requests for international and domestic shipments between sites and container movements from the Sea Port of Embarkation (POE) to the Sea Port of Debarkation (POD) shipped by surface or sealift. Performs Port Handling and Inland Transportation (PHIT) and ensures the subcontractor performs all duties and responsibilities according to the Statement of Work (SOW). Inspects and documents each shipment for contract compliance on a Customer Service Survey form. Processes Export Traffic Release Requests (ETRR) for sealift shipments using Surface Deployment Distribution Command (SDDC) - Integrated Booking System (IBS). Performs Host Country customs clearances and liaises with Military and Host country Ministries on Import and Export for Border Customs Clearances, Airport Customs Clearances and Seaport Clearances. Selects and initiates contact with local carriers to arrange appropriate transport equipment for containers, classified, sensitive, hazardous or outsized shipments based on the size, weight, commodity description, freight classification, required delivery date, priority or other special requirements. Loads/unloads 463L pallets, equipment, vehicles and ISO containers from flat-bed/low-bed trucks. May assist in loading/unloading military vessels at the seaport. Assists the Pallet and Net Managers with inspections, issuing, accounting, controlling, reporting and maintaining operation stock levels of 463 L pallets, nets and other tie-down equipment located on site. Assists the WPM Custodian with inspecting and certification, record keeping and reporting the receipt and usage requirements. Assists the CCO with completing the monthly container inventory, ensuring all containers located on-site are inventoried between the 1st and 30th day of each month. Reports all lost, damaged, destroyed and modified containers to the CCO within 12 hours of discovery. Performs container inspections and reports findings on the DA 2404 equipment inspection and maintenance worksheet. Receives/Ships all containers in JCM within 12 hours of receipt or departure. Operates GATES and ICODES to process and manifest cargo and to develop load plans for military and commercial aircraft. Prepares, inspects, reviews and submits Preload Plans, Hazardous Materials Diplomatic Clearances (HAZDIP) and other documents to facilitate air movement. Inspects cargo documentation, conducts Joint Inspections and certifies that cargo is built correctly and airworthy. Computes weight and balance and certifies weight distribution of the aircraft with passengers, cargo and baggage. Determines cargo configuration and aircraft loading requirements in accordance with Air Transportability Test Loading Activity Certifications (ATTLA). Loads, unloads and services aircraft. Ensures cargo loads are secure and tied down. Assists load team chief with selecting, assembling, palletizing and transporting cargo loads to and from aircraft storage areas. Safely transports and handles explosives. Performs passenger service procedures, check-in, manifest passengers and baggage and perform security checks. Loads/unloads passengers and baggage from aircraft. Performs weighing of cargo, vehicles and outsized cargo to determine the center of balance for rolling stock and ensures cargo dimensions are within pallet and aircraft limitations. Implements, documents and controls quality, training, environment and safety programs. Prepares and handles cargo in accordance with all prescribed regulations, instructions, technical orders and procedures. Accomplishes receiving process for all inbound cargo functions of MILSTRIP and NON-MILSTRIP shipments addressed to the host installation SRAN IAW with regulation. Maintains Technical Orders, publications, forms and files required for Traffic Management operations. Compiles data and submits reports and other correspondence as required. Performs other duties as assigned. Works in normal office and maintenance shop or warehouse environment and may be required to work outdoors for extended periods. Minimum Requirements Must be proficient in the use of personal computers and Windows Operating System and Microsoft Office to include as a minimum Power Point, Excel and Word programs. Knowledge of related shipping/receiving procedures and the ability to detect/report problems to appropriate personnel. Excellent organizational skills and the ability to effectively work under pressure and strict timelines required. Ability to maintain an effective working relationship with coworkers, including multi-national staff, and external and internal customers is required. Must be able to communicate clearly and concisely, orally and in writing to coworkers and customers while maintaining Communication Security (COMSEC), Operational Security (OPSEC) and Computer Security (COMPUSEC). Knowledge and understanding of MHE equipment operations and associated hazards required. Will be required to receive training and operate material handling equipment. Must possess a valid home country driver's license and ability to obtain host nation driver's license. High School diploma or equivalent required. Minimum of three years of experience in Traffic Management (TMO)/Air Freight operations or associate degree in a related field of study required. Experience may include but is not limited to import/export, freight acceptance, preparation, handling, cargo shipping/receiving by surface, sea and air, data records, container management, customer service, cargo operating computer systems or other related experience. Possess a current HAZMAT Certification in accordance with AFMAN 24-604 or ability to obtain it upon acceptance of the position. Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. Note: US Citizenship is required for facility credentials/authorization at this work location. Will be required to wear proper Personal Protection Equipment (PPE) according to prescribed procedures and as required for task being performed. Physically capable of performing all required duties; capable of lifting/pushing/pulling minimum of 50 lbs. Ability to travel domestically and internationally. Preferred Qualifications Experienced in aircraft cargo loading/unloading and cargo tie-down restraint procedures, palletizing cargo on single or multiple 463L pallets using side and top nets, straps, chains and devices for restraint preferred. Familiarization and certification in AMC Airlift Load Planning, or equivalent, and Joint Inspection process is preferred. new_matches.company: 佛山市顺德区金泰德胜电机有限公司
new_matches.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位概述： 系统工程师是连接客户需求与技术实现的核心桥梁。将负责商用电动车控制器（如 VCU、MCU、TCU）的系统级架构设计和需求定义。需要将整车级的目标转化成明确的软硬件技术规范，并在整个开发周期（V模型）中确保系统集成、功能安全及性能达标，以满足卡车和巴士在严苛工况下的运营需求。 岗位职责： 1. 需求分析与分解： 深入对接 OEM 客户，收集并分析整车需求。将原始需求分解为系统级需求、硬件需求及软件需求。 2. 系统架构设计： 定义控制器的系统拓扑结构、软硬分区及内部/外部接口。确保架构具备高扩展性和鲁棒性。 3. 通讯与网络设计： 负责车载网络方案设计，重点包括商用车标准的 J1939 协议矩阵设计、CAN-FD 及以太网通讯规划。 4. 功能安全协同： 配合功能安全经理（FSM），将安全目标（ASIL）转化为具体的技术安全要求（TSR），并落实到系统设计中。 5. 控制策略定义： 定义关键整车控制逻辑，如能量回收策略、扭矩分配方案、高压上下电逻辑及热管理协调。 6. 系统集成测试： 制定系统集成计划，主导 HIL（硬件在环）测试及整车环境下的系统功能验证，分析并解决复杂的系统级故障。 任职要求： 1. 教育背景： 车辆工程、电子工程、自动化或相关专业本科及以上学历。 2. 核心经验： 熟练英语口语表达能力。 5年以上 汽车电子系统开发经验，有 VCU、MCU 或整车动力总成控制器经验者优先。 熟悉商用车特有的系统特征（如 24V 系统、双回路气制动、多驱动轴控制等）。 2. 专业技能： 精通 V模型 开发流程和 ASPICE 标准。 熟练掌握 MATLAB/Simulink 建模仿真以及 Vector 工具链（CANoe, CANape）。 熟悉 ISO 26262 并在系统设计中应用过 HARA 和 FMEA。 3. 素质要求： 具备极强的系统性思维，能够从全局视角处理软硬件冲突；具备良好的跨部门沟通能力。

We are trusted by some of the world’s leading organisations to build reliable, high-performance, business-critical solutions – and expert advice. Our Platform Engineers are a vital part of this – designing, building and managing cloud infrastructure and delivery platforms to support modern DevOps practices. Their work includes CI/CD processes and deployment pipelines, building the platform infrastructure to deliver robust, cost-effective services to end users at scale, and supporting all stages of migrating complex systems from on-premises infrastructure to a multitude of cloud providers. These are hands-on, client-facing roles, with openings at senior or lead level to suit your experience. You may be leading teams, setting technical direction, advising clients or solving tough engineering challenges. Our clients include large global corporations and government departments, and you’ll be working on systems that make a difference to millions of people, within a company that is friendly, welcoming, and where individual contributions always make a difference. You have good CI/CD and deployment automation experience. You’re comfortable using Python or other scripting languages for DevOps tasks. You’re a problem-solver, pragmatically exploring options and finding effective solutions. You have strong communication skills and take a collaborative approach to your work. At Scott Logic, we value the flexibility of remote working alongside the value gained from spending time with our colleagues and clients. In our offices you’ll find employee-led clubs and events, as well as free games, books, and refreshments. We have shared values that govern our behaviour toward others and the environment. We are proud to be a B Corp, a global movement of businesses driving for a more inclusive, equitable, and regenerative economy.

new_matches.title: Traffic Management Specialist
new_matches.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
new_matches.description: Job Description The Traffic Management Specialist arranges the shipment of Pre-positioned Global Prepositioned Material Services (GPMS) cargo to various worldwide destinations via air, land and sea. The Incumbent must comply with all applicable International and Federal Transportation Laws, Regulations, Tariffs and Department of Defense (DOD) guidance. Must be able to gain access to Logistics Tool Suite (LTS), Global Freight Management (GFM), Cargo Movement Operating System (CMOS), Integrated Logistics System-Supply (ILS-S), Global Air Transportation Execution System (GATES), Integrated Computerized Deployment System (ICODES), Integrated Booking System (IBS), Joint Container Management system (JCM), Wood Packaging Materials (WPM) Management Toolset, Global Asset Reporting Tool (GART) and web-based tracking systems such as Integrated Data Environment/Global Transportation Network Convergence (IGC), Radio Frequency Identification (RFID-ITV) Tracking Portal, Global Decision Support Systems (GDSS-2) and Single Mobility System (SMS) to ensure In-transit Visibility (ITV) within the Defense Transportation System (DTS). Ensures all shipments comply with the International Trade and Arms Regulations (ITAR), the Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Amentum ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS). Must be able to complete AMMO-43, Intermodal Dry Cargo Container/CSC Reinspection, AMMO-62, Technical Transportation of Hazardous Materials Distance Learning Courses, and WPM certification/recertification web-based training. Ensures compliance with Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Amentum ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS). Principal Accountabilities Inspects, accepts documentation (DD Form 1149/1348-1), prepares and processes all outbound/inbound cargo offered for transportation in the Defense Transportation System (DTS). Checks for completeness and accuracy. Verifies the Nomenclatures, Quantity, Transportation Control Numbers (TCN), Transportation Account Code (TAC), Consignor and Consignee Codes, Hazardous/Classified materials, ITARS certifications and other essential transportation data. Properly classified freight, selects commodity codes, selects the most efficient mode of shipment and controls obligations for government transportation funds. Prepares all required shipping documents for data input to CMOS/GATES, assigns Transportation Control Numbers, produces labels, issues truck manifest for general/hazardous cargo and Maintains Manifest logs. Uses automated computer systems to process and document to accurately input the Transportation Control Numbers, Transportation Accounting Codes, consignor and consignee codes and other essential transportation data into CMOS, GATES or IBS. Inspects Hazardous Materials to ensure proper packaging, marking, labeling, documentation and certification in accordance with applicable Dangerous Goods Regulations (AFMAN 24-604, 49 Code of Federal Regulation, International Air Transport Association (IATA) and International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG). Inspects, accepts and inventories all incoming freight and containers for overages, shortages and damage before acceptance. When required, initiate and complete DD Form 361, Transportation Discrepancy Report (TDR). Provides asset visibility and real-time view to track customer queries using IGC, RFID-ITV, GDSS2 or SMS. Prepares shipping documents and Movement Requests for international and domestic shipments between sites and container movements from the Sea Port of Embarkation (POE) to the Sea Port of Debarkation (POD) shipped by surface or sealift. Performs Port Handling and Inland Transportation (PHIT) and ensures the subcontractor performs all duties and responsibilities according to the Statement of Work (SOW). Inspects and documents each shipment for contract compliance on a Customer Service Survey form. Processes Export Traffic Release Requests (ETRR) for sealift shipments using Surface Deployment Distribution Command (SDDC) - Integrated Booking System (IBS). Performs Host Country customs clearances and liaises with Military and Host country Ministries on Import and Export for Border Customs Clearances, Airport Customs Clearances and Seaport Clearances. Selects and initiates contact with local carriers to arrange appropriate transport equipment for containers, classified, sensitive, hazardous or outsized shipments based on the size, weight, commodity description, freight classification, required delivery date, priority or other special requirements. Loads/unloads 463L pallets, equipment, vehicles and ISO containers from flat-bed/low-bed trucks. May assist in loading/unloading military vessels at the seaport. Assists the Pallet and Net Managers with inspections, issuing, accounting, controlling, reporting and maintaining operation stock levels of 463 L pallets, nets and other tie-down equipment located on site. Assists the WPM Custodian with inspecting and certification, record keeping and reporting the receipt and usage requirements. Assists the CCO with completing the monthly container inventory, ensuring all containers located on-site are inventoried between the 1st and 30th day of each month. Reports all lost, damaged, destroyed and modified containers to the CCO within 12 hours of discovery. Performs container inspections and reports findings on the DA 2404 equipment inspection and maintenance worksheet. Receives/Ships all containers in JCM within 12 hours of receipt or departure. Operates GATES and ICODES to process and manifest cargo and to develop load plans for military and commercial aircraft. Prepares, inspects, reviews and submits Preload Plans, Hazardous Materials Diplomatic Clearances (HAZDIP) and other documents to facilitate air movement. Inspects cargo documentation, conducts Joint Inspections and certifies that cargo is built correctly and airworthy. Computes weight and balance and certifies weight distribution of the aircraft with passengers, cargo and baggage. Determines cargo configuration and aircraft loading requirements in accordance with Air Transportability Test Loading Activity Certifications (ATTLA). Loads, unloads and services aircraft. Ensures cargo loads are secure and tied down. Assists load team chief with selecting, assembling, palletizing and transporting cargo loads to and from aircraft storage areas. Safely transports and handles explosives. Performs passenger service procedures, check-in, manifest passengers and baggage and perform security checks. Loads/unloads passengers and baggage from aircraft. Performs weighing of cargo, vehicles and outsized cargo to determine the center of balance for rolling stock and ensures cargo dimensions are within pallet and aircraft limitations. Implements, documents and controls quality, training, environment and safety programs. Prepares and handles cargo in accordance with all prescribed regulations, instructions, technical orders and procedures. Accomplishes receiving process for all inbound cargo functions of MILSTRIP and NON-MILSTRIP shipments addressed to the host installation SRAN IAW with regulation. Maintains Technical Orders, publications, forms and files required for Traffic Management operations. Compiles data and submits reports and other correspondence as required. Performs other duties as assigned. Works in normal office and maintenance shop or warehouse environment and may be required to work outdoors for extended periods. Minimum Requirements Must be proficient in the use of personal computers and Windows Operating System and Microsoft Office to include as a minimum Power Point, Excel and Word programs. Knowledge of related shipping/receiving procedures and the ability to detect/report problems to appropriate personnel. Excellent organizational skills and the ability to effectively work under pressure and strict timelines required. Ability to maintain an effective working relationship with coworkers, including multi-national staff, and external and internal customers is required. Must be able to communicate clearly and concisely, orally and in writing to coworkers and customers while maintaining Communication Security (COMSEC), Operational Security (OPSEC) and Computer Security (COMPUSEC). Knowledge and understanding of MHE equipment operations and associated hazards required. Will be required to receive training and operate material handling equipment. Must possess a valid home country driver's license and ability to obtain host nation driver's license. High School diploma or equivalent required. Minimum of three years of experience in Traffic Management (TMO)/Air Freight operations or associate degree in a related field of study required. Experience may include but is not limited to import/export, freight acceptance, preparation, handling, cargo shipping/receiving by surface, sea and air, data records, container management, customer service, cargo operating computer systems or other related experience. Possess a current HAZMAT Certification in accordance with AFMAN 24-604 or ability to obtain it upon acceptance of the position. Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. Note: US Citizenship is required for facility credentials/authorization at this work location. Will be required to wear proper Personal Protection Equipment (PPE) according to prescribed procedures and as required for task being performed. Physically capable of performing all required duties; capable of lifting/pushing/pulling minimum of 50 lbs. Ability to travel domestically and internationally. Preferred Qualifications Experienced in aircraft cargo loading/unloading and cargo tie-down restraint procedures, palletizing cargo on single or multiple 463L pallets using side and top nets, straps, chains and devices for restraint preferred. Familiarization and certification in AMC Airlift Load Planning, or equivalent, and Joint Inspection process is preferred. new_matches.description: As the Lodging Logistics/Linen/Water Delivery Supervisor , you will support logistics services inclusive of water supply, lodging furniture moves, and linen services of personnel housed at ADAB. For logistics support of water, you oversee the water delivery team ensuring receipt and delivery of water pallets, managing inventory levels, and providing ready-to-order document for re-stocking requirements. In support of lodging furniture, you are responsible for storage, ordering, inventory, assembly & breakdown, installation, and removal & delivery of lodging furniture. Lodging furniture includes bed frames, refrigerators, dehumidifiers, nightstands, wall lockers and other related lodging furniture. Other duties may be assigned inclusive of assisting with other lodging duties inclusive of reservations, in-processing, out-processing of personnel lodged at ADAB. Other duties will also include placing work orders upon customer request for lodging facilities. Essential Job Functions As a Supervisor you shall determine quantities required and timely stock replenishment and rotation by use of experienced judgment, historical data, occupancy and utilization. You shall establish and maintain minimum stock levels of all expendable supplies and equipment to ensure adequate inventory of items with no more than two (2) unfulfilled lodging item requests due to depleted stock levels per month. Store, inventory, order, assemble, breakdown, remove, deliver, and install furniture, refrigerators, dehumidifiers, beds and other lodging related items in lodging rooms with no more than two (2) discrepancies per month. Maintain full inventory of lodging items in the storage facilities in an orderly manner with a system in place to account for all items with no more than two (2) discrepancies per month. Provide/oversee Water Delivery Services between the hours of 0700-1800 Monday through Saturday as needed. Responsible for delivery of water; responding to individual delivery requests; managing inventory levels; and providing a ready-to-order document to the Government for re-stocking requirements. You shall manage the water within the Class I storage area. Coordination to escort delivery trucks at the front gate and provide a USN Monitor of LNs/OCNs for the water delivery vehicles to one of the 3 water storage areas to ensure the water delivery contractor is always escorted. You will ensure the delivery trucks are fully escorted off the base after each water delivery has been completed. No escorting discrepancies allowed per month. Rotate the water pallets using the first in/first out method after each water delivery. Verify that no damage has occurred during delivery and after each pallet has been downloaded. Check that the shrink wrap integrity has been maintained for future pallet deliveries and sanitation. Remove one (1) bottle of water from each pallet and clearly mark it with the pallet number. You will then take each marked bottle of water and store them in the marked container for pickup by 380 ECES Bio Environmental to test the water. You shall contact 380 ECES Bio Environmental for water to be tested. You shall ensure all pallet and water bottles are marked with No discrepancies are allowed per month. You shall receive a confirmation from 380 ECES Bio Environmental that the water is suitable for consumption before it can be distributed and rotated into stock. The historical turnaround time for test results is 48-72 hours. As Supervisor, you shall manage a water delivery schedule for 110 identified facilities and drop off locations. You shall develop and submit the schedule to the COR for approval. You shall ensure all scheduled water drop areas are stocked with no more than two (2) stock outages allowed per month. Monitor and respond to emails or phone calls from requestors asking for pickup or delivery of water pallets for all the facilities at ADAB. Deliver water to / pickup water from each requested location within 24 hours after initial customer notification/request. Perform service with no more than two (2) late deliveries or pickups each month. Responsible for general cleanliness and trash removal, (cardboard, shrink wrap, etc.) from water delivery points to the appropriate dumpster. Collect empty water pallets and return to the vendor at the water storage areas daily. Education & Experience High School diploma or equivalent. 6K and 10K Forklift and 6K Boom lift experience (preferred). Previous military experience operating heavy equipment (preferred). Must have intermediate level skillset in computer functions including Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Access, and PowerPoint. Additional Requirement Must possess a valid U.S. Driver’s License Possess a valid U.S. Passport (preferred) Must be able to meet all current USCENTCOM Deployment Policy Requirements, as outlined in the USCENTCOM APR 23 MOD EIGHTEEN TO USCENTCOM INDIVIDUAL AND INDIVIDUAL-UNIT DEPLOYMENT POLICY Able to obtain and maintain a valid Residency Visa for the U.A.E. Must be able to work in extreme environmental conditions including dust and high temperatures. Must be able to endure long hours, exposure to weather and hazardous conditions. new_matches.title: Phone Tablet and computer repair service technician
new_matches.description: Company Description Applesoft Limited is a privately owned New Zealand company specializing in repairs for computers, Macs, laptops, iPhones, iPads, iMacs, MacBooks, and a wide range of other mobile phones. The company supports small and medium businesses as well as home users with reliable IT services. Applesoft Limited offers onsite IT support, remote IT support, and workshop-based repairs. Its services are available across Auckland, providing convenient and professional technical assistance to a diverse customer base. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site role based in Auckland for a Phone, Tablet, and Computer Repair Service Technician. The technician will diagnose and repair hardware and software issues on smartphones, tablets, laptops, desktops, and Apple devices, including component replacement and system configuration. Daily tasks include troubleshooting customer devices, performing routine maintenance, backing up and restoring data, and ensuring repairs are documented accurately in service systems. The role involves engaging with customers in person, explaining issues and repair options in clear, accessible language, and providing basic user support and advice. The technician may also assist with onsite and workshop IT support, including setup of devices, networks, and peripherals as needed. Qualifications Strong technical skills in diagnosing and repairing smartphones, tablets, laptops, desktops, and Apple devices (iPhones, iPads, iMacs, MacBooks). Knowledge of operating systems (Windows, macOS, mobile OS), software installation, configuration, and basic networking. Experience with workshop repairs, onsite support, and remote troubleshooting for small and medium businesses and home users. Ability to communicate clearly with customers, explain technical issues in simple terms, and provide high-quality customer service. Good organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple repair jobs and tickets efficiently. Relevant technical certification or trade qualification in IT, electronics, or computer servicing is beneficial. Previous experience in a repair or IT support environment and familiarity with health and safety practices in a workshop setting are advantageous.
